name: expense-webapp
description: Single-page React app serving employees, managers, and finance with role-specific views: submitting expense claims with receipts, reviewing/approving a team's claims, and exporting approved claims for payroll. Talks only to expense-api; holds no direct database or storage credentials.

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Backend API for expense claims, approvals, and payroll export — all reads and writes go through it.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client for signing in employees, managers, and finance users via SSO.
